customWittyPhrases: Buracle Stack tip: /plan-build writes a reviewed plan to docs/plan-build/, waits for your approval, then builds it test-first
Buracle Stack tip: /goal-build locks pass/fail criteria first, then builds in rounds a judge scores against them
Buracle Stack tip: /bugfix reproduces the failure, names the root cause as file:line and writes a failing test before the fix
Buracle Stack tip: Scope still unclear? /requirements asks a few rounds of questions and writes a PRD before any code
Buracle Stack tip: No workflow needed for small changes: ask directly and the agent still verifies before it reports done
Buracle Stack tip: Say stop, wait or hold on at any time: the agent finishes the current step and pauses the plan
Buracle Stack tip: Add --worktree after a workflow request to build it in its own worktree, squash-merged back when done
Buracle Stack tip: /research <question> answers from sources it actually read: web, library docs, public code and memory
Buracle Stack tip: /inspect <question> traces how the code really behaves, cites every hop as path:line and changes nothing
Buracle Stack tip: /dead-code reports unused code only when two independent signals agree, with a staged removal plan
Buracle Stack tip: Run /project-rules once per repository: it writes an AGENTS.md from commands it ran, for every harness
Buracle Stack tip: /remember <text> saves a note to the memory that Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Oh My Pi all share
Buracle Stack tip: Ask "why did we…" or "what did we decide…": the agent searches the memory before it answers
Buracle Stack tip: /brain opens the Buracle Stack Console: browse, search and fix the memory of this project and yours
Buracle Stack tip: /brain review opens the review page: pin notes on a plan, and the agent applies them before approval
Buracle Stack tip: /aside <question> answers a side question without derailing the running task
Buracle Stack tip: /buracle-status shows the active plan, the running workflow and the memory at a glance
Buracle Stack tip: Need a skill for a recurring task? /find-skill searches the registry, audits the pick and installs it everywhere
Buracle Stack tip: Did a procedure twice? /new-skill turns it into a skill every harness can load
Buracle Stack tip: Something feels off? `buracle doctor` checks config, hooks, MCP and LSP servers, memory and code indexes
Buracle Stack tip: `buracle update` updates Buracle Stack and everything it connects, each part from its own source
Buracle Stack tip: `buracle config set plan.<key> <value>` tunes how workflows run: worktrees, questions, reviews
Buracle Stack tip: Turn on plan.reviews.companion to get the same review from another installed harness as a second opinion
Buracle Stack tip: The same skills, rules, guards and memory run in Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Oh My Pi
Buracle Stack tip: `buracle mcp status` shows Buracle Stack's shared MCP servers; one backend serves every open session
Buracle Stack tip: codegraph and semble index each project in the background, so the agent finds callers without grep loops
Buracle Stack tip: `buracle plan audit` compares the diff with the files each task named and flags unplanned changes
Buracle Stack tip: Plans, PRDs and reports follow the language you write in; only the markers Buracle Stack reads stay English
